32: In the year 2035, convict James Cole reluctantly volunteers to be sent back in time to discover the origin of a deadly virus that wiped out nearly all of the earth's population and forced the survivors into underground communities. the husband. the wife. her sister. his friend.

They're selling music but not selling out.

Dr. Choma Kruvajan / Dr. Thomas Kruvajan

Two heads are better than one.

Adrian Veidt / Ozymandias / Minister / Benny Anger (voice)
Sally Jupiter / Silk Spectre / TV Broadcaster (voice)
Edgar Jacobi / Moloch / British Newscaster / Photographer #1 (voice)

Le jeune automobiliste au feu rouge
